column1: # Names RECOVERED BY SEARCH, not strings BF3 stores. Each is a verified preimage:
# hashQuickLowerCase(name) == hash, asserted on load. They are kept OUT of
# bf3_name_hashes.tsv, which is built only from strings the game itself contains.
# Search: 60,147,020 candidate-target tests over corpus-derived candidates,
# expected false hits 0.0140; a control of 126 random hashes over the same
# generators produced 0. Every hit is a directory sibling of the mesh that
# references it, which is the corroboration a wide search cannot offer.
